briefdescription.para: Derived artifact lifecycle, staleness policy, and invalidation management.

detaileddescription.para: This module defines the EPIC 2.6 Artifact Lifecycle contract for evaluation and planner consumption. It provides the freshness semantics, rebuild governance, and staleness detection hooks needed to coordinate retrieval quality with storage and compute constraints across the layered retrieval architecture.

sect2.title: Lifecycle States
sect2.para: Each artifact transitions through a finite state machine:

sect2.title: Staleness Policy
sect2.para: A staleness policy defines thresholds for when an artifact transitions from READY to STALE. Multiple overlapping policies may apply (age, delta lag, residual error, rank cap). The artifact becomes STALE if any policy fires.

listitem.para: Query Planner: Consumes artifact lifecycle state to make routing decisions
Recovery Manager: Uses lifecycle state to drive rebuild priorities
Artifact Manifest: Stores lifecycle metadata alongside artifact content
Background Workers: Drive INVALIDATED → REBUILDING → READY transitions
